'''Logru''',<ref name="DF" /><ref name="TT" /> also known as '''Loghru''',<ref name="EA" /> was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Honoghr (star)|Honoghr]] in the turbulent [[Honoghr system/Legends|Honoghr system]],<ref name="DF" /><ref name="TT" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Loghru was a tiny<ref name="DF" /><ref name="TT" />  [[Magma/Legends|molten]] rock<ref name="EA" /> with oceans of boiling lava<ref name="DF" /><ref name="TT" /> and had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]] as a supplement to [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]], named only three planets of the [[Honoghr system/Legends|Honoghr system]] – Loghru, [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], and [[Kuthul]] – although it stated that the system contained seven worlds.<ref name="DF" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], named the remaining worlds and placed the Honoghr star system in grid square T-10.<ref name="EA" />
